class="elementor-widget-container"><p>Sakalava Lodge is a boutique kitesurfing and wingfoil lodge located directly on the Sakalava Bay spot in northern Madagascar. Unlike standardized kite camps, we intentionally host few travelers: each stay is tailor-made, with individual support and a true riders' home atmosphere.</p><p>Families, independent riders, or beginners: you'll enjoy comfortable accommodation surrounded by nature, an IKO school, personalized coaching, and immediate access to the lagoon. For over 25 years, the lodge has been a benchmark for kitesurfing and wingfoiling in Madagascar, renowned for its consistent wind and warm welcome.</p></div></div><div class="elementor-element elementor-element-9b10cd4 elementor-icon-list--layout-traditional elementor-list-item-link-full_width elementor-widget elementor-widget-icon-list" data-id="9b10cd4" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="icon-list.default"><div class="elementor-widget-container"><ul class="elementor-icon-list-items"><li class="elementor-icon-list-item">
